label: Noise
description: reels pile up behind your head, one every quarter second

label: Lineup
description: numbered tiles fan out in an arc above your head

label: Locked On
description: corner brackets snap onto your face and the camera follows you

label: Orbit
description: your reels circle your head: in front at the bottom, behind you at the top

label: Lean In
description: a fast punch-in on one word

label: Backdrop Word
description: a giant word drops in behind you

label: Spotlight
description: kill the lights, keep you lit

label: The Bill
description: prints every instruction like a ticket, into the wall above your head

label: Moody
description: a moody colour grade: darker, softer, teal shadows

label: Swipe
description: a before and after slider that sweeps across you

label: Todo
description: a checklist card beside your head that ticks off as you talk

label: Comment Box
description: an Instagram comments sheet above your head types your word, posts it, gets a heart and your reply

label: Tap
description: a Follow button pops up and flips to Following

label: Pause Point
description: freeze the frame and point at something with a hand-drawn arrow

label: Uninstall
description: a glitchy uninstall bar that breaks the frame apart

label: Reel Frame
description: your video shrinks into an Instagram reel card

label: Shortcut Rain
description: keyboard keys rain down behind you

label: Reject Stamp
description: a big red stamp slams onto the screen

label: Countdown Flip
description: a 3, 2, 1 flip clock above your head

label: Rabbit Hole
description: the frame tunnels into itself, spinning

label: Cover Star
description: you become a magazine cover, with the title behind your head

label: Scribble
description: marker doodles draw themselves around you

label: Glass Widgets
description: frosted glass phone widgets and mini artifacts float around your head, with an Edited with ReelOS pill

label: Red Collage
description: black and white you, a giant red word behind, kinetic type stacked beside you

label: Split Headline
description: a clean headline card slides down and pushes you into the bottom of the frame

label: Pastel Word
description: a soft lavender backdrop, a giant word behind you and a profile card that gets followed

label: Check Pills
description: grid-paper room, your reels pinned behind you and blue pills that get clicked

label: Timeline
description: a dark red cinematic grade with an editing timeline, a REC timecode and a glowing playhead

label: Headline Box
description: a punch-in with a clean two-line headline, the second line in a white box

label: Profile Wall
description: your profile grid fills the wall behind you while a counter ticks up

label: Tier List
description: a tier list drops in front of you and ReelOS flies into S tier

label: Broll Split
description: split screen: b-roll on top with a price-tag sticker, you on the bottom

label: Phone Fan
description: your reels fan out like a hand of phones in front of you, under a two-line headline

label: Dot Reveal
description: your shot builds itself out of glowing dots, then snaps into the full picture

label: Headline Wall
description: a wall of your own reel headlines piles up behind your head, then your total views pop in front

label: Checklist
description: a ReelOS task list builds under your chin: each step spins, then ticks green

label: Liquid Glass Graph
description: a liquid glass card floats under your chin while a graph climbs and the number counts up

label: Carousel Spin
description: your reels spin around you in a 3D carousel, then slow to a stop

label: Match Cut
description: news pages cut on one word, locked in place behind your head

label: Apple Toggles
description: an iPhone settings card under your chin flips its switches on, one line at a time

label: Led Sign
description: the lights drop and a glowing LED sign types itself out behind you

label: Slow Push
description: a slow cinematic push-in from the wide shot to your face, the room melting out of focus

label: Over The Shoulder Zoom
description: the camera pushes into one top corner, a liquid glass graph pops beside your head, then the other corner with a second graph

label: Messages
description: iMessage notifications pop in one after another, creamy glass with a soft glow, stacking up above the bottom of the frame

label: Place In Grid
description: you shrink into the centre tile of your 3x3 profile grid on frosted glass, then 8 of your reels pop in around you, one per frame, view counts on every tile
